const int MOD = 998244353;
long long memoTable[105][25][11];
char sequence[105];
int seqLen;

long long compute(int index, int prevRem, int value) {
    if (index == seqLen) {
        return prevRem == 0 ? 1 : 0;
    }
    if (memoTable[index][prevRem][value] != -1) {
        return memoTable[index][prevRem][value];
    }
    long long total = 0;
    if (sequence[index] == '_') {
        for (int digit = 0; digit < 10; digit++) {
            if (index == 0 && digit == 0) continue;
            int newRem = (prevRem * 10 + digit) % 25;
            total += compute(index + 1, newRem, value);
        }
    } else if (sequence[index] == 'X') {
        if (value != 10) {
            total += compute(index + 1, (prevRem * 10 + value) % 25, value);
        } else {
            for (int digit = 0; digit < 10; digit++) {
                if (index == 0 && digit == 0) continue;
                int newRem = (prevRem * 10 + digit) % 25;
                total += compute(index + 1, newRem, digit);
            }
        }
    } else {
        int digit = sequence[index] - '0';
        total += compute(index + 1, (prevRem * 10 + digit) % 25, value);
    }
    return memoTable[index][prevRem][value] = total;
}
